title: Smart Meter Data Validation and Estimation

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Smart Meter Data Validation and Estimation": Validate interval meter reads, detect gaps and spikes, and estimate missing values with flags so billing and analytics use trustworthy data. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Overwriting raw reads.
